description: This file provides services for auditing login activities, including fetching login activity logs with filters and recording new login activities, specifically for enterprise platform users.

methods.name: aMonthAgo
methods.description: Returns a Date object representing one month prior to the current date.

methods.name: setDateToStartOrEndOfDay
methods.description: Sets the time of a given date string to the start or end of the day.

methods.name: fetchLoginActivity
methods.description: Fetches login activity logs with optional filters for date range and activity codes, supports pagination.

methods.name: recordLoginActivity
methods.description: Records a login activity for a user, only if the platform is enterprise.
